panunics.summary: PANUNICS is a long-term intellectual framework developed by Junming Chen. This page is its permanent home: principles, essays, and ongoing work.
panunics.summaryZh: 统域学（PANUNICS）是陈俊名长期构建的思想体系。本页为其长期主页，收录核心理念、文章与在研工作。

principles.title: I. Emergence is not complexity growth
principles.body: Emergence is not a byproduct of uncontrolled complexity growth. It is the result of domain formation after the failure of high-dimensional distributed coordination. 涌现不是复杂度增长的副产物，而是高维分布式协调失败后的成域结果。

principles.title: II. The central contradiction is sustainability
principles.body: The central question of a system is not whether it is complex, but whether the expansion of its degrees of freedom can be sustained under finite accessible state capacity. Compression becomes necessary. 核心矛盾不是复杂与否，而是自由度扩张能否在有限可达容量下持续。

principles.title: III. Singular features are compressed outputs
principles.body: Macroscopic singular features are not accidental patterns. They are stable outputs after accessible state capacity has contracted: band gaps, magnetic order, vortices, generalized rules, stable conformations, states, firms, institutions. 宏观奇异特征是容量收缩后的稳定输出，不是偶然图样。

principles.title: IV. Boundaries are conditions, not accidents
principles.body: Boundaries are conditions of sustained stable domains. Without boundaries, a system cannot separate internal high-dimensional detail from external coupling requirements — and without that separation, encapsulation does not exist. 边界是稳定域得以维持的条件，而非次级现象。

principles.title: V. Hierarchy is reorganization, not accumulation
principles.body: Hierarchy is the reorganization of encapsulation domains. A stable domain defines a new individual; a new individual brings a new budget boundary; a new budget boundary begins a new compression. 层级是封装域的重组：新个体、新预算边界、新压缩过程。
